description: Mapping used by Sync-CabinetKitFromPosio.ps1 to audit/sync generic cabinet shell updates from posio.cabinet into posio/cabinet-kit.

rules.copy: Files that should stay mechanically mirrored after package-specific prefix/name changes have already been extracted.
rules.manual: Files that share ancestry with posio.cabinet but are intentionally generalized in the package. Review diffs, port ideas by hand.
rules.package_only: Files owned by the package integration layer; they have no source counterpart in posio.cabinet.

entries.notes: Package entry points at the original admin.scss. The original admin entry loads shared before admin partials.

Verbatim copy of the source page. Tabs it declares props for but does not ship (licenses, cash accounts, cashflow items, integrations) simply never render: settingsTabs.js keeps only tabs whose file exists. Route names it calls are bridged by the ROUTE_ALIASES map in createApp.js.
Verbatim copy. The full Posio tab catalogue stays as-is on purpose — the file-presence filter is what trims it down to the tabs the package actually ships.
Verbatim copy — the only settings tab the package ships (profile, password, interface language, sound notifications).

Form validation rules. Domain-specific rules of the source (national company code, national IBAN) are left out; messages interpolate locally because the package translation helper takes no parameters.
Only card shell ideas may be useful; source file is document-specific.
Package table is minimal by design. Port fuller table behavior only after deciding it is generic.
Package model must keep a small schema: owner_id, name, settings, expire.
Port only generic membership/role behavior. No onboarding/demo/product data.

System roles/permissions and their grants mirror posio.cabinet one-to-one (also watch its permission migrations). Account level: only roles named in cabinet-kit.roles and manage-members/manage-account; POS permissions stay out.
Package repository should not depend on the host repository base class.

Package repository carries only the social find-or-create half. No user-event milestones, no host locale service. The default system role is granted as in the source (cabinet-kit.default_system_role).

Package controller logs through the framework logger instead of the host app log, guards unconfigured providers, and redirects to the configured login route. Like the source, a new user gets no account here: post-registration steps (config/cabinet_onboarding.php in the source) are not ported, i.e. all off.
Keep Spatie team context behavior generic.
Verbatim apart from the namespace. Mounted in routes/cabinet.php outside the configurable cabinet-kit.middleware list, so a host cannot open the cabinet to an unconfirmed user.

Verbatim apart from the namespace. Added to the fixed part of CabinetKit::cabinetMiddleware() ahead of NotVerified, after the host-configurable list (which keeps the framework 'auth'): there it remembers every opened cabinet page as the intended one; its own guest redirect only fires for a host list without 'auth'.

Verbatim apart from the namespace and the CabinetRedirects import. Replaces the framework 'guest' alias on the package's guest auth routes: the framework default sends a signed-in user to the host's 'dashboard' or 'home' route.
Package route file owns only auth/dashboard/settings/account shell routes.

Composer package integration: migrations/routes/views/config/Inertia paths. Also carries the log-viewer wiring that lives in the source app's AppServiceProvider: the sysper-log-view auth callback, ported as-is, plus the route_path the source keeps in its published config/log-viewer.php (the package cannot publish that file, so it sets the value at runtime from cabinet-kit.log_viewer.route_path).
Host scaffolding and install diagnostics.
Override-aware page resolver used by consumer Vite entry.

Package adds guards absent from source: skip notification_channel without a logged-in user, skip Echo subscription when window.Echo/broadcasting is unavailable, and wrap the mark-as-read request in try/catch (route may not exist on a host without the queue/broadcast setup).
Package keeps a slightly older/simpler open() implementation. Diff before syncing dropdown positioning changes.

Generic table shell shared with posio.cabinet; source has product-specific filter tweaks (counterparty filters) not ported. Not the same file as components/ui/Table.vue (see ui-table entry), which is a separate minimal table.
Package version is intentionally smaller: no licenses, guest accounts, or POS/retail configuration fields.
Package version drops the retail/orders/kitchen configuration matrix (Posio-specific business formats); kept minimal, role-based only.

Package's own _admin-section header (used by Permissions/UsersAdmin pages), distinct from the generalized top-level copy tracked as layout-cabinet-header. Strips AiChatWidget/TelegramAssistantButton and other Posio-specific widgets.

Package's own _admin-section layout (used by Permissions/UsersAdmin pages), distinct from the generalized top-level copy tracked as layout-cabinet-layout. ProductTour/SpotlightHints/FirstReceiptCongrats blocks, tour state and onTourFinished are carried verbatim and gated by the shared `onboarding` prop (config cabinet_onboarding, all off in the package). The menu layer / cabinetShellPresence rework and the FirstStepsChecklist dock are not ported.

Package's own _admin-section side menu (used by Permissions/UsersAdmin pages), distinct from the generalized top-level copy tracked as layout-side-menu. Settings dropdown reuses resources/_admin/js/pages/Settings/settingsTabs.js and links via route('cabinet-kit.settings', { settings }) — same as the source apart from the route-name prefix; keep in sync with resources/js/layouts/SideMenu.vue if the settings tab contract changes.
Package version is ahead of upstream: upstream still carries a broken remove-by-key helper that references fields of an unrelated object. Do not overwrite from upstream until that is fixed there.
Same shape and global-$H contract as the original, but only the helper namespaces the package actually ported (Ar/ar, Dt/dt). Add a namespace here when porting its helper module.
Ported as-is except init(): createApp.js hands it the module-level Emitter singleton (resources/js/posio/system/Emitter.js), which is also what the api client emits pause events on.
Same module-level singleton contract as the source, built on the package's own resources/js/emitter.js instead of the mitt npm package — host projects must not need an extra dependency for it.
Verbatim copy. Returns the {statusCode, error, message, errors, data} envelope the card/table mixins read — a plain fetch wrapper that throws on 4xx cannot replace it.
Verbatim copy. Registered with app.use(Toast); colors come from --success-color/--error-color already shipped in colors_shared.scss.

Verbatim copy. createApp.js calls useAccentedDialogs(); the dialog classes it names already ship in popup_shared.scss / popup_admin.scss, and the bundled sweetalert2 stylesheet is resources/scss/vendor/_sweetalert2.scss.
Verbatim copy. The endpoint belongs to the host: createApp.js resolves the first route name of its dictionariesRoute option and passes null (with a console warning) when none is registered.
Verbatim copy. createApp.js only imports it — instantiation is what defines console.msg/console.wrn that ported code calls; the source app additionally silences the original console in production.
Verbatim copy. Base class of the dictionaries store; writes through _proxy so the reactive wrapper sees changes.
Same barrel as the source minus SettingsClass, which is not ported — the package keeps its own settings service factory in createApp.js. Add an export here when porting its module.
Verbatim copy. Factory that configures the api client for the cabinet (origin + /api/v1/, cookie auth).
Verbatim copy. Responsive card grid with a trailing add tile; card content comes from the slot.

Verbatim copy, Posio filter registry included: entries whose dictionary the host does not ship simply never render — a page only gets the filters it asks for. Needs $settings global/page state and the real $dictionaries.
Verbatim copy. Icon grid for editable categories; no dependencies beyond Iconify.
Same key set on both sides, different values: posio lands on its dashboard, the package on a page it actually ships. Never mirror the values.

One source controller is split across the package's Login/Register/PasswordReset/Verification controllers. Redirect targets are read from the redirects config on both sides; the package additionally falls back when a target names no registered route. Registration creates the user only, as in the source; the source's post-registration steps (config/cabinet_onboarding.php: account_setup, team_notification, user_milestones) are product logic and stay unported — the package runs with all of them off.
Detects an account still holding the password the installer seeded it with (config cabinet-kit.system_users). Install-time concern of the package; posio.cabinet has no counterpart.

Holds a seeded account on the password form, mirroring how posio.cabinet's HaveCurrentAccount holds a user without an account on cabinet.init. Also aliased as cabinet-kit.system-password for host route groups.
Screen + update for the forced password change. Shaped after InitController::initScreen (redirect away when there is nothing to do).
Modelled on posio.cabinet pages/InitFirst.vue: CabinetLayout with disable_menu plus an unclosable ModalForm opened on mount. Keep the two in sync in shape, not in content.
Modelled on pages/Initial/CreateAccount.vue (ModalCard + _formMixins + footer button). No source counterpart.
Shared image uploader used by the brand settings sections.
Brand settings section. Upstream route names admin.api.sitesettings.* are resolved through ROUTE_ALIASES in createApp.js, so the file stays byte-identical.
Public-site brand page (BrandSettings scope=main).
Cabinet brand page (BrandSettings scope=cabinet). Named apart from CabinetSettings.vue, which is the settings-tabs page in both projects.
SEO records table. Upstream route names cabinet.api.seodata* are resolved through ROUTE_ALIASES.
SEO record card. The AI button posts to seodata.generatemeta, which answers 'not configured' until cabinet-kit.seo.meta_generator is set.
Head component rendering meta/OG/Twitter/JSON-LD from the seo prop.
Verbatim apart from namespace/model import and the app-name fallback.

Namespace + the two product-specific parts made config-driven: sitenav route list (seo.sitenav_routes) and the SoftwareApplication node (seo.software.*).
Namespace + generateMeta delegates to cabinet-kit.seo.meta_generator instead of the host's AiService.
Rewritten without the project's _RepositoryClass base (account scoping and dictionary normalizators do not apply); same public API and same is_deleted flag.
Namespace + single-locale branch builds the URL through loc_route instead of using the raw route name.
Only loc_route is carried over, guarded by function_exists so a host keeps its own.
Same keys, neutral values; adds seo.software.* and seo.sitenav_routes, which are hardcoded upstream.
Shared queue behind every bottom-right floating element; a second element stacks above the first instead of covering it.
Wrapper every FAB/CTA goes through; owns the fixed positioning so no floating element declares its own.
Generic status dot used by the table's `dot` column type.
Registry of standard row/group actions (event -> icon -> tooltip) plus the colour resolver. Pages describe only the event.

Registers a nested block's page actions in the layout registry so they reach the user panel. Generic: the descriptor carries no product fields.
User panel; renders page actions above Settings. Package version drops Posio-only entries and keeps cabinet-kit.* route names.

Same file name and keys as the source, merged under the same config name so ported code reads it as is. Package values are all false except registration_approval, which the package turns on (the source keeps it off); comments explain which steps the package does not ship (account setup, first-steps checklist, team notification, milestones).

Logs through the framework logger instead of the host app log, reads the user model from cabinet-kit.user_model, the system team from cabinet-kit.system_team_id, and counts SAdmin role holders and the configured sa email as approvers (the source uses general.sa_user).
Renamed under the package's Require* convention; JSON answer omits the host-specific redirect field. Mounted on the cabinet group right after NotVerified.

Module API registry (routes under the cabinet stack, system permissions, dictionaries, translations, sitemap providers, menu, doctor/sync-config hooks). No upstream counterpart: posio.cabinet has no modules.
